name: 20636 · Hollywood, MD
findings: ZIP 20636 (Hollywood) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (58% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20636 (Hollywood) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
